title: The Hidden Spring
text: A spring in a fold of the hills, clean and cold, bubbling up through white sand into a pool that never seems to empty. Deer tracks crowd the bank. It would water a whole House's herds for a hundred years, and nobody else seems to know it is here.

options.label: Mark it on the House's maps, and claim it before anyone else does.

outcomes.text: A place to come back to, and to build on.

options.label: Drink and rest by the water, and let the deer keep you company.

outcomes.text: Clean water, clean heads, and the deer come down to drink beside you.

options.label: The craftiest fouls the spring, so that no rival can ever use it.

outcomes.text: Spiteful work, and the deer stop coming, and something in the hills notices what you did.
